Self-contained check of the **source HD-EEG** branch of
`5_peak_prevalence_modelled_power.qmd`. Instead of reading the cached normalized
PSD CSV, it rebuilds the input from the raw Mantini source signals — exactly as
the clustering / BIC notebooks do: `load_sources` → `compute_psd` (Welch) →
`relative_psd_df` (unit in-band normalisation) — so any artefact baked into the
CSV would show up here. It then fits specparam with the BIC-selected **fixed**
aperiodic model and converts the fit with `pesco.spectral.specparam2pandas`
(one row per fitted peak, carrying aperiodic params + per-spectrum metrics).
`specparam2pandas` exposes specparam's native error as **MAE** (`error_mae`), so
the quality screen here is R² > 0.9 & MAE < 0.1 (the figure doc uses MSE).

```{python}
#| label: config
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from specparam import SpectralGroupModel

from pesco.io import load_sources
from pesco.preprocess import compute_psd
from pesco.bandpower import relative_psd_df
from pesco.spectral import specparam2pandas

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
specparam_dir = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/specparam_model_selection"
DATA_PATH_SOURCES = PROJECT_DIR / "data/Mantini2018"  # raw HD-EEG source signals

FREQ_RANGE = (1, 80.0)
APERIODIC_MODE = "fixed"  # HD-EEG choice from the knee-vs-fixed BIC comparison
SPECPARAM_SETTINGS = dict(
    peak_width_limits=[1, 12],
    max_n_peaks=8,
    min_peak_height=0.15,
    peak_threshold=2.0,
)
assert DATA_PATH_SOURCES.exists(), f"missing {DATA_PATH_SOURCES}"
```

```{python}
#| label: helpers
def attach_metadata(sp, meta):
    """Add channel / region / Lobe to a specparam2pandas table via its ID column.

    ``ID`` is the row index of the fitted spectrum, so it maps straight onto the
    metadata rows in fit order.
    """
    sp = sp.copy()
    ids = sp["ID"].to_numpy()
    sp["channel"] = meta.index.astype(str).to_numpy()[ids]
    sp["region"] = meta["Region name"].astype(str).str.strip("'").to_numpy()[ids]
    sp["Lobe"] = meta["Lobe"].astype(str).to_numpy()[ids]
    return sp
```

## Load raw signals → Welch PSD → normalise

```{python}
#| label: load
raw, meta = load_sources(DATA_PATH_SOURCES)
# load_sources returns metadata row-aligned with the channel order; key it by
# channel name so it joins onto the PSD table.
assert len(meta) == len(raw.ch_names)
meta = meta.set_axis(pd.Index(raw.ch_names, name="ch_name"))

freqs, psd_raw = compute_psd(
    raw.get_data(), raw.info["sfreq"], fmin=FREQ_RANGE[0], fmax=FREQ_RANGE[1]
)
psd_df = pd.DataFrame(
    psd_raw, index=pd.Index(raw.ch_names, name="ch_name"), columns=freqs
).join(meta)

# Unit in-band normalisation — the actual specparam input (matches the figure doc).
psd_norm = relative_psd_df(psd_df, freqs)
psd = psd_norm[list(freqs)].to_numpy(dtype=float)
meta = psd_norm[[c for c in psd_norm.columns if isinstance(c, str)]]
print(f"channels {psd.shape[0]} | freqs {freqs[0]:.1f}-{freqs[-1]:.1f} Hz "
      f"({psd.shape[1]} bins, Δf={np.median(np.diff(freqs)):.3f})")
```

## Fit and extract

```{python}
#| label: fit
fg = SpectralGroupModel(
    **SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, aperiodic_mode=APERIODIC_MODE, verbose=False
)
fg.fit(freqs, psd, freq_range=list(FREQ_RANGE), n_jobs=1)

# pesco.spectral.specparam2pandas → long table, one row per fitted peak; spectra
# with no peak still appear (NaN peak columns), each carrying its aperiodic
# params and per-spectrum fit metrics.
sp = attach_metadata(specparam2pandas(fg), meta)

# Peaks only, and a one-row-per-channel fit-quality table for the screen.
peaks = sp.dropna(subset=["CF"]).reset_index(drop=True)
quality = sp.groupby(["ID", "channel"], as_index=False).agg(
    gof_rsquared=("gof_rsquared", "first"),
    error_mae=("error_mae", "first"),
    n_peaks=("CF", lambda s: int(s.notna().sum())),
)
```

```{python}
fg.report()
```

## Summary

```{python}
#| label: summary
passed = (quality["gof_rsquared"] > 0.9) & (quality["error_mae"] < 0.1)
pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "value": [
            "Mantini2018 (raw → Welch PSD → relative)",
            APERIODIC_MODE,
            f"{FREQ_RANGE[0]}-{FREQ_RANGE[1]} Hz",
            len(meta),
            len(peaks),
            round(quality["n_peaks"].mean(), 2),
            round(quality["gof_rsquared"].median(), 3),
            round(quality["error_mae"].median(), 4),
            f"{passed.sum()}/{len(quality)} ({passed.mean():.1%})",
        ]
    },
    index=[
        "input",
        "aperiodic mode",
        "freq range",
        "channels",
        "total peaks",
        "mean peaks/channel",
        "median R²",
        "median MAE",
        "pass R²>0.9 & MAE<0.1",
    ],
)
```

#| label: save
out = specparam_dir / "verify_hd_eeg_peaks.csv"
peaks.merge(
    quality[["channel", "gof_rsquared", "error_mae"]], on="channel"
).to_csv(out, index=False)
out.name
